honesty_boundary: The identity is proved in the explicit constant-curvature model spaces (warped products R x_s S^n with s the D10 Jacobi field: sin/cosh/r branches), i.e. geodesic normal coordinates of the sphere/flat/hyperbolic space forms, reduced to a radial ODE (jet) computation; the abstract-Riemannian-manifold statement is out of scope for D11.

The D10 Euclidean Bochner identity on R^n is consumed verbatim (kernel-checked) and its radial restriction in normal coordinates is proved equal to the flat case of the model identity; the curvature correction is computed as the Riccati term m' + m^2 = -k, the honest radial reduction of Ric(d_r, d_r) = -n s''/s = n k.
|Hess u|^2 is the Hilbert-Schmidt norm (radial (u'')^2 plus n tangential (m u')^2 contributions); no operator-norm claim is made.
The hypothesis jacobiSol k r != 0 excludes the pole (r = 0) and, on the sphere, the antipodal cut locus - exactly the validity domain of normal coordinates.

Regularity is u' differentiable plus u'' differentiable at r (implied by C^3, bridged in Basic.lean); the gradient-estimate chain additionally excludes critical points u'(r) != 0, as in the classical Li-Yau statement.
The D7 bridge instantiates the D7 finite-dimensional pointwise certificates from the model data; no D7 or D10 file is modified.

model_dictionary.modelGradSq: modelGradSq u r = (deriv u r)^2  [|grad u|^2, grad u = u' d_r]
model_dictionary.modelLap: modelLap n k u r = u'' + n * m_k * u'  [Laplacian in normal coordinates, m_k = s'/s]
model_dictionary.modelHessSq: modelHessSq n k u r = (u'')^2 + n * m_k^2 * (u')^2  [Hilbert-Schmidt norm of the Hessian]
model_dictionary.modelGradDot: modelGradDot u f r = u' * f'  [<grad u, grad f>]
model_dictionary.modelRicciTerm: modelRicciTerm n k u r = n * k * (u')^2  [Ric(grad u, grad u) for Ric = n k g]
model_dictionary.riccati: m' + m^2 = -k (jacobiMeanCurvature_riccati), s''/s = -k, -n s''/s = n k

headline_theorems.name: euclidean_bochner_identity_restated
headline_theorems.statement: ContDiff R 3 u -> forall x, D10.lap (fun y => ||D10.grad u y||^2) x = 2 * D10.hessNormSq u x + 2 * <D10.grad u x, D10.grad (D10.lap u) x>
headline_theorems.role: D10 Euclidean Bochner identity consumed verbatim (D10 restatement requirement 1a)

headline_theorems.name: radial_bochner_identity
headline_theorems.statement: lapG n m (gradSq u) r = 2 * hessSq n m u r + 2 * gradDot u (lapG n m u) r + 2 * ricTerm n m u r
headline_theorems.role: the radial Bochner-Weitzenboeck identity for an ARBITRARY warped profile m, with the curvature term -n(m' + m^2)(u')^2; unconditional jet computation

headline_theorems.name: model_bochner_weitzenbock
headline_theorems.statement: modelLap n k (modelGradSq u) r = 2 * modelHessSq n k u r + 2 * modelGradDot u (modelLap n k u) r + 2 * modelRicciTerm n k u r
headline_theorems.role: THE target identity Delta||grad u||^2 = 2||Hess u||^2 + 2<grad u, grad Delta u> + 2 Ric(grad u, grad u) in the constant-curvature model, unconditional in k (requirement 1b)

headline_theorems.name: jacobiMeanCurvature_riccati
headline_theorems.role: the Riccati equation m' + m^2 = -k: the curvature term of the identity, from the D10 Jacobi ODE

headline_theorems.name: subharmonic_energy_density_of_nonneg_ricci
headline_theorems.statement: 0 <= k -> deriv (modelLap n k u) r = 0 -> 0 <= modelLap n k (modelGradSq u) r
headline_theorems.role: Ric >= 0 => subharmonicity of the energy density (requirement 2a)

headline_theorems.name: model_bochner_inequality_of_nonneg_ricci
headline_theorems.statement: 0 <= k -> 2 * modelHessSq n k u r <= modelLap n k (modelGradSq u) r - 2 * modelGradDot u (modelLap n k u) r
headline_theorems.role: unconditional (non-harmonic) Bochner inequality - the Li-Yau/Hamilton workhorse

headline_theorems.name: gradient_estimate_inequality
headline_theorems.statement: K <= n * k -> deriv (modelLap n k u) r = 0 -> 2 * modelHessSq n k u r + 2 * K * (deriv u r)^2 <= modelLap n k (modelGradSq u) r
headline_theorems.role: Ric >= K => the gradient-estimate differential inequality (requirement 2b)

headline_theorems.name: gradient_estimate_of_norm
headline_theorems.statement: K <= n * k -> deriv (modelLap n k u) r = 0 -> deriv u r != 0 -> K * |deriv u r| <= modelLap n k (fun s => |deriv u s|) r
headline_theorems.role: the classical pointwise estimate Delta|grad u| >= K|grad u| via Kato + product-rule split

headline_theorems.name: modelBochnerCertificate
headline_theorems.statement: a D7 BochnerCertificate whose bochner field is the D11 identity Delta_1 = grad*grad + Ric on du
headline_theorems.role: D10->D7 connection: the D11 identity as the kernel-checked field of the D7 certificate (requirement 3)

headline_theorems.name: d7_gradient_estimate_gives_model_subharmonic
headline_theorems.statement: 0 <= k -> deriv (modelLap n k u) r = 0 -> 2 * modelHessSq n k u r <= modelLap n k (modelGradSq u) r
headline_theorems.role: the D7 GradientCertificate.gradient_estimate recovers the D11 corollary chain conclusion

headline_theorems.name: d7_estimate_iff_ricci_nonneg
headline_theorems.statement: deriv (modelLap n k u) r = 0 -> (2 * modelHessSq n k u r <= modelLap n k (modelGradSq u) r) <-> 0 <= modelRicciTerm n k u r
headline_theorems.role: sharpness: the D7 estimate holds exactly when the Ricci pairing is nonnegative - curvature used essentially

proof_outline: gradSq u = (u')^2, hence (gradSq u)' = 2 u' u'' and (gradSq u)'' = 2 (u'')^2 + 2 u' u''' (deriv_gradSq, deriv_deriv_gradSq)
(Delta u)' = u''' + n (m' u' + m u'') (deriv_lapG)
Delta(|grad u|^2) = (p^2)'' + n m (p^2)' = 2(q^2 + n m^2 p^2) + 2 p (t + n(m' p + m q)) + 2 (-n (m' + m^2) p^2) = 2|Hess u|^2 + 2<grad u, grad Delta u> + 2 ricTerm (ring; radial_bochner_identity)

for the model profile m = s'/s the Riccati equation m' + m^2 = -k (jacobiMeanCurvature_riccati, from the D10 Jacobi ODE via HasDerivAt.div) makes ricTerm = n k (u')^2 = Ric(grad u, grad u) (model_bochner_weitzenbock)

corollary chains: harmonicity drops <grad u, grad Delta u>; Ric >= 0 gives subharmonicity and the unconditional inequality; Ric >= K gives Delta|grad u|^2 >= 2|Hess u|^2 + 2K|grad u|^2; Kato + product-rule split give Delta|grad u| >= K|grad u|

D7 bridge: the frame sums identify ricciPairing/hessNormSq/gradLaplacianDot with the model quantities; modelBochnerCertificate/modelGradientCertificate carry the identity into the D7 structures; round trips recover the D11 corollaries
negative_results_and_limits: Constant-curvature model spaces only; the arbitrary-Riemannian-manifold Bochner-Weitzenbock identity is out of scope for D11 (D12 layer).
|Hess u|^2 is the Hilbert-Schmidt norm; no operator-norm statement.
Normal-coordinate validity domain: jacobiSol k r != 0 (pole and antipodal cut locus excluded).
The gradient estimate Delta|grad u| >= K|grad u| requires u'(r) != 0, as in the classical statement.
The D10 identity is restated and used, not reproved; the D7 certificates are instantiated, not modified.
